reframed_request: «Мы хотим больше продаж через соцсети. У сотрудников есть телефон и 20 минут в неделю.» → Turn ≤17 planned staff minutes a week of phone footage into countable orders that start as coded WhatsApp chats. Because no product line, number or date was given, the first 4-week sprint is diagnostic across 4 in-stock lines: digital pianos, beginner electric guitars with amps, ukuleles, and the site's sale section.
business_objective: Expected +12 orders (conservative 6 / stretch 20) closed from coded WhatsApp chats, spread across digital pianos, beginner electric guitars and amps, ukuleles and «Распродажа» items, by 2026-11-15. The target is re-fixed as a multiple of the week-0 inbound count on 2026-11-01, because no sales baseline exists yet.
marketing_objective: People in Astana, and buyers elsewhere in Kazakhstan who need delivery, who are about to buy a specific instrument in the next few weeks and can't decide which model or whether it is worth the money message the store's WhatsApp with a video code and ask about a named model, by 2026-11-15. Examples: a parent choosing a digital piano for a child who is studying music, a beginner choosing a first electric guitar and amp, someone picking a ukulele as a gift.

success_metric.name: Orders from coded WhatsApp chats (all 4 test lines), with coded chats as the sub-count
success_metric.how_measured: Per-video {CODE} counted in the weekly WhatsApp chat export, plus the staff label «Оплачен» on coded chats. Site orders where the buyer gives a code are added. Codeless chats are asked «Откуда о нас узнали?». Total weekly inbound vs week 0 is reported separately as an estimate, because codes undercount.
success_metric.target: Orders: conservative 6 / expected 12 / stretch 20. Coded chats: conservative 25 / expected 50 / stretch 80. Baseline: 0 coded chats. Total inbound chats and close rate are unknown, so the week-0 count (2026-10-12…18) becomes the baseline and the targets are re-fixed as a multiple of it at the end of week 2 (2026-11-01).

leading_indicators: views_48h ÷ platform median: pooled music_instruments_retail median until 10 own posts, then the median of the last 15 own posts on that platform
shares + saves per 1,000 views vs account median
coded WhatsApp chats per 1,000 views, per line (piano / guitar+amp / ukulele / sale)
constraints: BUDGET: 0 ₸ (default; known_unknowns says no ad budget is assumed)
OWNER: ≤15 min onboarding, ≤5 min/week, one batched message. There is no direct contact yet; all asks go through Andrey (MetaPrompt) and Pavel, so expect relay delays (evidence)
STAFF: 20 min/week stated → ≤17 planned min/week, with the 15% safety margin (stated + default)

FILMING: one mid/low-quality phone. Audio is usable only with the phone held close to the instrument (stated), so sound shots are at 20–30 cm and speech only with the phone at the mouth. Faces: consent not asked yet, so hands, instruments and voice only until consent is recorded. Customers only with consent recorded on camera. Minors (e.g. children at the piano) only with a parent's written OK (default)

PRICES: only site prices ≤7 days old, re-fetched before publishing. The 2026-10-08 facts (Hibilly, Mapex, Alston, Caesar) expire 2026-10-15. Piano prices may come only from the 2026-10-09 ids (web_…_price). px770_price, ap270_price and diff_pno are marked do_not_use. The derived ids hib_disc, mapex_disc and diff_uke have no source or date, so they are usable only if recomputed from same-day ledger prices (evidence)

OFFER: no new offers. The existing site sale (sale_page; e.g. hib_old→hib_price, mapex_old→mapex_price) may be shown exactly as published. The word «Финальная», any end date or any reason for the sale only after the owner confirms them (default + evidence)

CAPACITY: retail, so capacity = stock per SKU from the site (e.g. PX-770 3 шт, AP-270 5 шт as of 2026-10-09; some sale items 1 шт). «в наличии» or a quantity may be used in copy only if ≤48 h old and re-fetched on publish day. Chat-handling capacity is unknown. No «завтра» or fast-delivery claims (default)
REGULATED: not a regulated category. No learning-outcome promises («научитесь за месяц»). Children appear only under the FILMING rule (default)

AVOID: politics, religion, ethnicity, mocking customers, naming competitors or other Kaspi sellers. Do not repeat the site's «100% оригинальный товар» in audience copy: it is an absolute claim with no third-party source. Do not promote the returns clause «компенсация доставки за честный отзыв» (incentivised reviews) (evidence + default)

ACCOUNTS: YouTube exists (3 620 subs, 379 videos, median 2 300 mostly long-form, last upload 2026-05-10). Instagram muzzone_astana exists but could not be analysed (blocked anonymous fetch). VK muzzoneastana and Facebook muzzonemusicshop exist. TikTok: none linked; ownership unknown (owner ask). Business accounts may use commercial-library music only; the instruments' own sound is preferred (evidence)
APPROVAL: the owner explicitly approves each weekly batch, via the intermediaries. Offers, new faces and spend always need an explicit «да» (default)
GUARDRAIL: median first WhatsApp reply ≤15 min during working hours (пн–пт 10:00–19:00, сб 10:00–17:00 per the hours fact); measured from the week-0 export

GUARDRAIL: returns must not rise vs the prior period. Content may not oversell sound or quality, because the 14-day return policy (returns_14d) makes overselling expensive: shipping both ways is withheld
GUARDRAIL: no conversion push on SKUs with ≤1 unit in stock unless stock is re-checked on publish day
LANGUAGE: Russian for all audience copy. Kazakh captions only after a native speaker's check (profile lists ru and kk)
assumptions: Ladder (built internally): «больше продаж» → more instrument orders → the first weekly-countable number is orders from coded WhatsApp chats. It forks three ways: (a) high-ticket digital pianos, highest value per order and stock 3–5 per model; (b) beginner guitar + amp, the best-proven interest, since the top YouTube video is a beginner electric guitar demo at 64 000 views; (c) clearing the «Распродажа» stock. Margins are unknown, so no branch can be ranked on margin. The first sprint therefore spreads across all three plus ukuleles (gift price band 22 100–64 501 ₸), and data picks the line for sprint 2.

BOTTLENECK: awareness + consideration, low confidence (hypothesis, no chat data). Evidence: no social posting found since 2026-05-10 (last YouTube upload); brand-only demos underperform (L006: 390 vs 2 300 median, n=48); considered purchases with prices up to 734 886 ₸ (AP-270) where buyers must choose between similar models; delivery-and-returns friction is visible in returns_cost. Conversion stage (reply time, close rate) is unknown until the WhatsApp export arrives. If replies take more than 60 min, that becomes the top fix before more content.

SECONDARY: should_we_do_social. The boss's wording implies they want to know whether social can sell at all. This gets no extra slots; it is answered at week 4 by coded chats and orders per staff hour vs a threshold agreed in week 0.

SECONDARY: YouTube search line. A plain model-name or comparison title cross-post costs zero staff minutes (L002, L004: long-form search titles respond; L003: they did not replicate on Shorts). It gets ≤20% of effort and is measured separately.

REALISM: req_chats = 12 orders / 0.25 [ASSUMPTION close rate] = 48. req_views = 48 / (0.3–3 per 1k [ASSUMPTION, 10× range]) = 16k–160k. ach_views = 20 posts × 3 platforms (TikTok/Reels/Shorts cross-post) × 500 [ASSUMPTION Shorts/Reels median for a dormant or new account; YouTube's 2 300 is long-form] × 1.8 ≈ 54k. ratio = 0.3–3.0, feasible to stretch, driven almost entirely by the unknown chats-per-1k rate. Replace with own numbers after week 2. Capacity is not binding except on low-stock SKUs. Time: 5 weeks is >14 days, so organic can learn, but a warm-base push (WhatsApp Status to existing contacts) is added from week 1.
[ASSUMPTION] close rate of WhatsApp chats ≈25% | if wrong: order targets rescale proportionally | verify: count chats ending in payment, address or pickup in the WhatsApp export by 2026-10-18

[ASSUMPTION] the WhatsApp number +7 701 0987734 (fact wa) is the one staff actually answer, and they can apply labels | if wrong: codes go to a different number or are lost | verify: Pavel confirms during week-0 setup, by 2026-10-14

[ASSUMPTION] Most buyers decide in Astana, but sales elsewhere in Kazakhstan via free delivery over 100 000 ₸ (delivery_free_100k) are in scope | if wrong: CTAs drop the delivery angle | verify: share of out-of-city chats in the export by 2026-10-18

[ASSUMPTION] No TikTok account exists; one is created in week 0 and treated as a cold start (no arm judgement on its first 5–10 posts) | if wrong: we audit the existing account | verify: owner ask in the onboarding batch

[ASSUMPTION] Timing: the music-school year is under way, so parents are choosing pianos now. New Year gift demand (ukuleles, beginner guitars) peaks after this sprint, so gift-angle ideas are pre-tested now and scaled in sprint 2 (planned 10–14 days before the moment) | if wrong: shift the gift angle earlier | verify: week-2 coded chats per line

Judgement call beyond the METHOD: the boss gave staff time but no line, date or number, so the A7 'vague request' rule applies, with the A2 sales_push default and a diagnostic first cycle rather than a single named SKU.
clarifying_questions: Что важнее продать в ближайшие 5 недель: 1 — цифровые пианино, 2 — электрогитары и комбики для начинающих, 3 — укулеле, 4 — товары из раздела «Распродажа», 5 — пробуем всё понемногу и смотрим, что сработает? По умолчанию: 5. Ответ до 10.10 18:00.

Почему распродажа на сайте называется «Финальная»: 1 — магазин закрывается или переезжает, 2 — уходим от этих брендов/моделей, 3 — обычная распродажа без срока, 4 — есть дата окончания (напишите дату)? По умолчанию: слово «финальная» и любые сроки в роликах не используем, скидки показываем только как на сайте. Ответ до 10.10 18:00.
Кого можно снимать: 1 — только руки, инструменты и голос, 2 — продавцов с лицом (с их согласия), 3 — и покупателей (с их согласия)? По умолчанию: 1. Ответ до 10.10 18:00.
